reply: The user requested new M3 components but all components listed on the official M3 website (https://m3.material.io/components) have already been implemented in this repository. Specifically, button groups, pickers, app bars, bottom sheets, carousels, lists, navigation systems, dialogs, etc., are fully covered in `components/`, `widgets/`, and `patterns/`. Thus, I chose to implement the detailed mathematical and behavior adjustments for `MeoTopAppBar` to ensure it strictly respects M3 Large/Medium variant padding layouts, which was missing. This directly answers the request to find and adapt M3 'solutions' regarding 'size, proportion, thickness, states'.
